sections.description:
🔔 The Most Powerful WordPress Notification Bar Plugin

HashBar is a powerful WordPress Notification Bar Plugin that will take your WordPress site to the next level. Create unlimited announcement bars with advanced customization options, professional design controls, and intelligent targeting to maximize your engagement and conversions.

Sometimes notification bars can increase up to 500% of subscribers or conversions!

👉 Plugin Landing Page | Live Demo | Purchase Pro | Documentation | Support 👈

🎬 Video Tutorial

🎯 Key Highlights

  • 🎨 Advanced Design Options – Choose from solid colors, beautiful gradients, or background images for eye-catching notifications
  • 💻 Custom CSS Editor (Pro) – Add professional CSS styling with a code editor featuring syntax highlighting
  • 📊 A/B Testing (Pro) – Test multiple variations of your notification bars to find the winning design
  • 🎬 5 Entry & 5 Exit Animations – Multiple animation options to grab attention (Free version includes all 10!)
  • 📈 Comprehensive Analytics – Track impressions, clicks, and CTR to measure success
  • 🎯 Smart Targeting – Display notifications based on pages, devices, countries, and user behavior
  • ⏱️ Countdown Timers – Create urgency with fixed, recurring, or evergreen countdown timers
  • 📝 Message Rotation (Pro) – Rotate multiple messages with automated scheduling
  • 🔧 Easy to Use – Intuitive admin interface with live preview of changes

HashBar is an easy-to-install plugin for WordPress, allowing you to easily create notification bars that work perfectly on all resolutions (Desktop/Tablet/Mobile). sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the HashBar – WordPress Notification Bar plugin and get it working.

1) Install

Modern Way:

  1. Go to the WordPress Dashboard “Add New Plugin” section.
  2. Search For “HashBar”.
  3. Install, then Activate it.

Old Way:

  1. Unzip (if it is zipped) and Upload hashbar-wp-notification-bar folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

2) Configure

  1. After install and activate the plugin you will get a notice to install CMB2 Plugin, please install it to get this plugin’s full functionality
  2. To install the plugin click on the “install” link from the notification
  3. ‘HashBars’ Menu will be appear in Backend
  4. Create new HashBar and relax!
sections.faq:
Is coding knowledge required to use HashBar?

No coding knowledge is required! HashBar features a visual editor with live preview. You can create professional notification bars using simple controls. However, the Pro version includes a Custom CSS Editor for advanced users who want more control.

Can I create unlimited notification bars?

Yes! Both Free and Pro versions allow you to create unlimited notification bars. Display different messages on different pages, or show multiple bars simultaneously.

Does HashBar work with my theme?

Yes, HashBar is designed to work with all standard WordPress themes. It has been tested with popular themes like Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress, Kadence, Divi, and many others.

Can I target visitors from specific countries?

Yes! HashBar includes country targeting for 50+ countries in the FREE version. You can show different notification bars to visitors from different countries.

Does HashBar work with Elementor, Gutenberg, and other page builders?

Absolutely! HashBar works seamlessly with:

  • Gutenberg (includes 4 native blocks)
  • Elementor
  • WPBakery Page Builder
  • King Composer
  • Classic Editor (via shortcodes)

Can I schedule notification bars to appear and disappear automatically?

Yes! You can set start and end dates with specific times. Your notification bars will automatically appear and disappear based on your schedule.

Does HashBar include a countdown timer?

Yes! The Free version includes a fixed countdown timer. The Pro version adds recurring countdown (resets daily) and evergreen countdown (personalized per visitor for FOMO effect).

Will HashBar slow down my website?

No! HashBar is built with performance in mind. It uses optimized asset delivery, lazy loading, and lightweight code. The notification bars load smoothly without affecting your page speed.

Is HashBar mobile responsive?

Yes! All notification bars are fully responsive. You can also set different visibility options for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I track how my notification bars are performing?

Yes! HashBar includes a built-in analytics dashboard that tracks impressions, clicks, and click-through rate (CTR). The Pro version adds per-variant tracking for A/B tests.

Does HashBar work with WooCommerce?

Yes! HashBar integrates with WooCommerce. You can target specific products, product categories, or display bars only on your shop pages.

Can I use HashBar with WPML for multilingual sites?

Yes! HashBar is fully compatible with WPML, allowing you to create translated notification bars for your multilingual website.

What is A/B testing and is it available?

A/B testing allows you to create multiple variants of your notification bar and automatically split traffic between them to find the best performer. This feature is available in the Pro version.

What is an evergreen countdown timer?

An evergreen countdown is a personalized timer that starts fresh for each visitor. Unlike fixed countdowns, every visitor sees their own countdown, creating a personalized sense of urgency (FOMO effect). This is a Pro feature.

Is there a money-back guarantee?

Yes! HashBar Pro comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you’re not satisfied, you can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase.

How do I get support?

Free users can access community support through WordPress.org forums. Pro users get priority email support through the HasThemes support system.
